headline: Poundland Moves Toward Administration Threatening UK Retail Chain
summary: Poundland's leadership has filed a formal notice of intention to appoint administrators, leaving the British discount retailer's future uncertain as it nears potential collapse.
why: Poundland is a major UK high-street discount retailer; insolvency threatens thousands of retail jobs and commercial retail leases.

impacts.name: Poundland
impacts.why: Filing intention to enter administration signals severe liquidity distress.
